sources.title: Architecture graph for CodeSoft/sorbet-v2-25m | hfviewer
sources.snippet: CodeSoft/sorbet-v2-25m architecture at a glance CodeSoft/sorbet-v2-25m is a text-generation model (qwen2 architecture). It uses 14 transformer layers, a hidden size of 384, and 6 query heads with 2 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 1,024.
